retainedReference.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful pictures plus ordinary viewer PMTiles/DEM. An initial plaza view showed adjacent buildings and is excluded from mosque controls. No photo pixels are shipped.

pictures.author: Elyasaf Freiman
pictures.observations: Inspected800×600 gateway view:yellow masonry,white outlined pointed blind niches,a deep pointed central recess over a rectangular passage,projecting toothed coping and a tapered minaret with blue/cream bands and an open capped lantern. The cropped view does not establish a measured whole facade;second tower and plan positions remain estimates supported by the gate composition.

pictures.author: G41rn8
pictures.observations: Inspected960×720 hall view:slender green timber columns with molded bases,white transverse beams and small curved brackets beneath a flat white ceiling. The model abstracts this vocabulary for the sheltered courtyard veranda;carpets,lamps,fans and furnished interiors are omitted.
